notes.title: Mac compatibility
notes.content:
- Bring back MacOS support (Required specs: OpenGL 3)

notes.title: User interface update
notes.content:
- Add Material Icons by Google 

- Replace a lot of text with icons 

- More intuitive interface

- Reduce the number of runtime librairies to avoid compatibility issues (use stb_image instead of FreeImage, stb_truetype instead of FreeType) 

- Change Windows compiler from Visual C++ to g++ 

Édgimon is still planned to be released this year: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763090/dgimon/

notes.title: Workshop feature
notes.content:
You can now create your own puzzles and share them with other players. 

To create a level: 
- On the main menu, press "Puzzle Editor". 
- To create a new folder, click the "New" button on the left and drag it. 
- To create a new puzzle, click the "New" button on the right and drag it. 
- In the "Edit" tab, you can define the tiles of the level. 
- In the "Test" tab, you can test your level. 
- In the "Workshop" tab, you can upload your level to workshop. 

To play puzzles created by other players:
- Go to the community workshop in Steam and subscribe to an item.
- On the main menu, press "Workshop Subscriptions". 
- Select the item in the top left menu.
